verdicts.reason: Both lose the can's cream backing circle: it drifts off to the bottom-left corner, and the can body ends up orange on orange, so the product is nearly invisible. A has a strong, readable headline column, but the subcopy is oversized and wraps so 'now.' sits alone on a line, and the NEW/Try It pair is squeezed against the right edge. B's headline is far too small for the canvas, its subcopy is tiny, and the pieces are scattered: NEW floats top-right, the CTA doesn't line up with the text column, and there is a lot of dead space.
